entries.ee7a7232bdac2d62: A business in which subsidiaries operate supermarkets centered on food products in Hokkaido, Tohoku, northern Kanto and other areas. As of February 28, 2026, the Group has a total of 374 stores. Because retail-related businesses account for most of the Group, it is disclosed as a single segment, the retail-related business. Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥626,957 million (up 3.1% from the previous year), with food accounting for 87.4% of sales.
